bio: I'm a freelance designer and developer working with founders, studios, and brands to ship websites and digital products that punch above their weight.
For the last six years I've focused on the intersection of editorial design, motion, and front-end engineering — the kind of details that turn a good site into a memorable one.
Available for freelance projects, art direction, and the occasional speaking gig.
